description: Return detected supply changes from the delta feed. Pass the `cursor` you last stored to get only newer changes; omit it for the full feed. Each response includes `latest_cursor` — store it and pass it next time. The feed is not retrospective: events predating change detection carry no change record (see the feed limitations).

cursor.description: The `latest_cursor` from a previous call (e.g. "2026-08"). Omit for all changes.

name: changes_since
title: Supply changes since a cursor
